components.name: Durable scientific storage
components.purpose: Private versioned storage retains authenticated inputs, accepted results and provenance. Public access is blocked.

components.name: Working and cache storage
components.purpose: Separate versioned storage retains workflow work/cache according to distinct retention policies.

components.name: Service identities
components.purpose: Separate roles bind storage, registry and log responsibilities. The HealthOmics role is workflow-wide; truth isolation between callers and evaluators comes from staged dataflow.

components.name: Immutable image registry
components.purpose: Private immutable repositories retain exact scientific and Explorer image digests.

components.name: Execution logs
components.purpose: Dedicated log groups retain provider execution observations; accepted evidence must be archived independently.

components.name: Managed scientific workflow
components.purpose: Nextflow defines process dependencies, input staging, requested resources and task/cache behavior. Provider execution is accepted separately.

components.name: Optional Batch compute
components.purpose: Compute environment and job queue declarations are disabled by default. No live Batch claim is made.

components.name: Separate Explorer hosting
components.purpose: The separate module describes an immutable-image service and readiness route. It requires exact-image memory qualification before activation; no current deployment is inferred.

relationships.relationship: Workflow service permissions govern scientific storage, image pulls and logging.
Authenticated reference, read and domain inputs are staged by the workflow.
Completed outputs and accepted evidence are retained durably.
Intermediate work and cache are separate from durable evidence.
Tasks resolve immutable scientific image digests.
Provider execution emits logs and task observations.
Optional execution backend; not activated by this snapshot.
Hosting pulls the reviewed Explorer image.
No runtime private-storage access; public evidence is bundled in the image.
